title: ODIN pipeline starter kit: Docker Compose stack, deployment profiles and demo data for the ODIN pipeline web application
description: Starter kit for the ODIN application, a browser-based tool for registering, launching and tracking sequencing (Oxford Nanopore) and qPCR (Biomeme) workflows, with results visualised in Enlighten. Provides a ready-to-run Docker Compose stack using the published application images, deployment profiles and seed files, and anonymised demo data to try it out; the basis for running ODIN on your own data.
